citation: Probe framework written to test whether the tool works on corporate disclosure rather than interviews, and on a polarity model whose values are not P/N. Not a validated instrument.

description.en: A minimal four-dimension scheme for reading corporate sustainability reports, written only to test portability. The polarity model asks whether a passage substantiates a claim or merely asserts it, which is the recurring problem in disclosure research. It ships because it is the least similar framework available: a non-interview corpus, descriptor fields that have nothing to do with people, and poles named S and A rather than P and N. Several defects were only ever found by running it. Replace it with a real instrument (GRI, SASB, TCFD, ESRS) before using it for research.
description.zh: 為了測試可攜性而寫的四維度極簡架構，用來讀企業永續報告書。極性模型問的是「這段話是有憑據的揭露，還是只是宣稱」——那正是揭露研究反覆遇到的問題。它之所以隨工具一起發行，是因為它是手上最不像預設框架的那一個：語料不是訪談、屬性欄位跟人無關、兩極叫 S 和 A 而不是 P 和 N。有好幾個缺陷是靠實際跑這個框架才被發現的。真要做研究，請換成正式工具（GRI、SASB、TCFD、ESRS）。

polarity.citation: Substantiated = the passage gives a figure, a boundary, a method or a verifiable reference. Asserted = a commitment or achievement stated without any of those.

descriptor_source.en: the cover, the About-this-report section, the reporting-boundary statement and the assurance statement
descriptor_source.zh: 封面、關於本報告書章節、報告邊界說明與確信聲明

definition.en: Statements about what the organisation intends to achieve, by when, and measured against what starting point.
definition.zh: 組織打算達成什麼、何時達成、以哪一年為基準衡量。

en: a numeric target with a target year
an explicit baseline year and baseline value
scope of the target (which entities, which emissions scopes)
restatement of a previously published target, with the reason
zh: 帶年度的量化目標
明確的基準年與基準值
目標涵蓋範圍（哪些實體、哪些排放範疇）
對先前已公布目標的重述，並說明原因

en: an ambition with no number attached ("net zero by 2050" with no interim figure)
a target with no stated baseline
a target whose scope is left unspecified
a previously published target quietly dropped or changed
zh: 沒有數字的抱負（只說「2050 淨零」卻沒有中期數字）
沒有說明基準的目標
未界定涵蓋範圍的目標
先前公布過的目標被悄悄拿掉或更改

en: A description of an action already completed is not a target. Targets are forward-looking.
Regulatory minimums the entity is required to meet are not targets unless the entity commits to going beyond them.

Do NOT code a passage as asserted-only merely because you cannot verify the figure from the report alone. A stated figure with a stated baseline is substantiated disclosure even if you cannot audit it.
zh: 描述已經做完的事情不算目標，目標是前瞻的。
法規要求的最低標準不算目標，除非報告主體承諾超越它。
不可以因為「光看報告書無法查證這個數字」就判成僅為宣稱。有數字、有基準的揭露就是有憑據的揭露，能不能稽核是另一回事。

definition.en: How a reported figure was produced: the method, the reporting boundary, what was estimated, and what was left out.
definition.zh: 一個揭露數字是怎麼算出來的：方法、報告邊界、哪些是估算、哪些被排除。

en: named calculation method or protocol
stated organisational or operational boundary
explicit exclusions from the figure
distinction between measured, calculated and estimated values
zh: 明確指名的計算方法或協定
已說明的組織或營運邊界
明確排除在數字之外的項目
區分實測、計算與估算

en: a figure presented with no method and no boundary
"in accordance with international standards" without naming one
year-on-year comparison where the boundary changed and this is not said
a total that cannot be reconciled with the parts disclosed elsewhere
zh: 沒有方法也沒有邊界的數字
只說「依據國際標準」卻不指名是哪一個
邊界改變卻未說明的逐年比較
與報告書他處揭露的分項對不起來的總數

en: The presence of a number is not by itself substantiation. A number with no method and no boundary belongs to the asserted pole.
A methodological appendix elsewhere in the report counts: if the passage cites it, code the passage as substantiated.
Do not code the absence of a figure as evidence about measurement quality unless the report claims to report that figure.
zh: 出現數字本身不構成憑據。沒有方法也沒有邊界的數字屬於宣稱那一極。
報告書別處的方法論附錄算數：段落若有指向它，就編為有憑據。
不可以把「沒有某個數字」當成量測品質的證據，除非報告書自稱會揭露那個數字。

definition.en: Who inside the organisation is answerable for sustainability outcomes, and through what mechanism.
definition.zh: 組織內部誰為永續成果負責，透過什麼機制負責。

en: a named body or role with stated responsibility
frequency and content of board-level review
link between sustainability outcomes and remuneration, with the weighting
escalation route when a target is missed
zh: 有明確職責的具名單位或職位
董事會層級審議的頻率與內容
永續成果與薪酬的連結，並說明權重
目標未達成時的處理途徑

en: "the board oversees sustainability" with no mechanism
a committee named but with no stated remit, membership or cadence
remuneration described as linked to ESG with no weighting or metric
accountability asserted for outcomes the entity does not control
zh: 只說「董事會監督永續」卻沒有機制
點名了委員會，卻沒有職權、成員或開會頻率
說薪酬與 ESG 連結，卻沒有權重或指標
為自己無法控制的成果宣稱課責

en: An organisation chart is not governance evidence unless responsibility for sustainability outcomes is attached to a position on it.
A policy document existing is not accountability. Accountability needs a consequence: who answers, to whom, when the outcome is missed.
Do not infer weak governance from silence. Code only what the report states.
zh: 組織圖不算治理證據，除非圖上的某個位置被賦予永續成果的責任。
有一份政策文件不等於課責。課責需要後果：沒達成時誰要向誰交代。
不可以從沉默推論治理薄弱。只編報告書真的寫出來的東西。

definition.en: How outside parties were consulted and whether their input demonstrably changed anything.
definition.zh: 如何徵詢外部各方意見，以及那些意見是否確實改變了什麼。

en: identified stakeholder groups and how they were selected
method and timing of consultation
issues raised, in the stakeholders' own terms
a decision that changed as a result, named
zh: 已辨識的利害關係人群體及其選取方式
議合的方式與時點
以利害關係人自己的語彙陳述的議題
因此而改變的具名決策

en: a list of stakeholder categories with no method attached
a materiality matrix with no account of how positions were obtained
"we engage regularly with our stakeholders"
issues reported only in the entity's own framing
zh: 只列出利害關係人類別，沒有說明方法
有重大性矩陣，卻沒有交代座標是怎麼來的
只說「我們定期與利害關係人溝通」
議題只以報告主體自己的框架陳述

en: Counting how many people were surveyed is not engagement quality on its own; what matters is whether anything changed.
Customers buying the product and employees being employed are not stakeholder engagement. Engagement requires consultation about the entity's conduct.
Philanthropy and community sponsorship are not engagement unless the recipients shaped a decision.
zh: 問卷發了幾份本身不構成議合品質，關鍵是有沒有東西因此改變。
顧客買產品、員工受雇不算利害關係人議合。議合要求就報告主體的作為進行徵詢。
公益捐助與社區贊助不算議合，除非受贈方影響了某個決策。
